description: A large, blue, half oval sits at the center of the composition. The shape fades from pale gray at the bottom center to dark blue towards its edges. Below the oval form is a band of purple and greenish gray. The abstract composition gives the sense of an expanse of lightening dawn sky over a flat landscape.
